If the handle mechanism is damaged, replace the handle assembly.

Address low-coolant warnings promptly to avoid thermal derate or pack damage.

reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Small chips outside the driver's critical vision area can sometimes be resin-repaired if addressed immediately. Cracks and any delamination require full windshield replacement using an OEM panoramic unit and recalibration of the forward camera/ADAS. Document delamination early and pursue warranty/goodwill coverage; a quality PPF or windshield film reduces future chip risk.
